## Issue

- **Number:** #369
- **Title:** Add SDK acceptance criteria verification script

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Verification script or checklist generator is added.
- [ ] Package command is available.
- [ ] Output includes tests, CI, docs, and acceptance criteria reminders.
- [ ] Documentation explains how contributors should use it.
- [ ] PR template references the verification step.
- [ ] README links to the workflow.

## Contributor confirmations

- [ ] Automated checks passed (`npm run verify:pr`)

- [ ] Documentation updated when public behaviour changed
- [ ] PR description maps each acceptance criterion to the change
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` values committed
